(BY SHRI Y.D. YADAV - GOVT. ADVOCATE )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.59/2023 registered at Police Station-Station Road Pipariya, District-Narmadapuram (MP) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(DA), 376(2)(n)
of Indian Penal Code and under Section 6/18 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and under Section 3(1)(w)(i), 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v), 3(2)(va) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: 1 2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix in her statement dated 01.04.2023 recorded by police, no allegations were made against the applicant or other co-accused persons namely Rajaram and Arjun.
Later on, allegation of rape was made against the applicant.
It is submitted by him that applicant is in jail since 05.04.2023.
Co-accused in the case has already been enlarged on bail.
In these circumstances, applicant may also be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that in 164 statement, prosecutrix has stated that applicant had committed rape on her.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
In initial statement which was recorded by police, no allegations of rape were made against the applicant.
Later on, allegations of rape were made against the applicant.
Co-accused in the case namely Arjun, Govind and Beena were enlarged on bail by this Court.
Case of applicant is on party.
Investigation is complete.
Prosecutrix has already been examined in Court.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
. C.C.
as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
